ytd:checklistTemplates.description: Full concept-to-archive production checklist covering every stage of making a video.
ytd:checklistTemplates.name: Standard Video Production Checklist

items.text: Define the core idea in one sentence
Confirm it fits a content pillar
Check it hasn't been done recently on this channel
Find 3 similar videos on other channels
Note the gap/angle this video will fill
Confirm hook, body, and CTA are each planned
Get a second pass if needed
Log b-roll to the Asset Library
Pick final title with keyword placement
Add end screen linking related video/subscribe
Note what to change next time

ytd:globalTemplates.content: I Tried [X] For [Timeframe] — Here's What Happened
ytd:globalTemplates.name: Curiosity Gap

ytd:globalTemplates.content: [Option A] vs [Option B]: Which Is Actually Better?
ytd:globalTemplates.name: Versus

ytd:globalTemplates.content:
One-sentence hook summarizing the video.

In this video: [1-2 sentence expansion].

⏱️ Timestamps:
0:00 Intro

🔗 Links mentioned:

📌 Subscribe for more [niche] content: [channel link]

#tag1 #tag2 #tag3
ytd:globalTemplates.name: Standard Description

ytd:globalTemplates.content:
Primary keyword: in title (first 8 words), first line of description, one of the first tags, spoken aloud in the video (for auto-captions).
Secondary keywords: sprinkled naturally through the rest of the description, additional tags.
ytd:globalTemplates.name: Keyword Placement Checklist

ytd:globalTemplates.content: Layout: subject face (left or right third) + 3-5 word high-contrast bold text + saturated background. Avoid more than one focal point.
ytd:globalTemplates.name: Face + Bold Text

ytd:globalTemplates.content: Layout: vertical split, "before" state left, "after" state right, small arrow or VS mark in the center.
ytd:globalTemplates.name: Before/After Split

ytd:globalTemplates.content:
Mission statement:
Target audience:
Content pillars (3-5):
Brand voice (3 adjectives):
Color palette:
Typography (heading/body):
Upload schedule:
ytd:globalTemplates.name: Channel Identity One-Pager

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Single static medium shot, eye-level, optional second angle for cutaways.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Ask a direct question tied to the topic, point to comments.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Jump cuts to remove pauses/filler words, subtle zoom punches on key lines.
ytd:videoTemplates.equipment: One camera, lav or shotgun mic, 2-point lighting.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Lower-third name/title, keyword callouts as on-screen text.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: State the surprising claim or promise in the first sentence, before any branding.
ytd:videoTemplates.motionGraphics: Simple animated text pop-ins, no heavy VFX.
ytd:videoTemplates.musicStyle: Low, unobtrusive bed under talking, swell only at transitions.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Talking Head
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Direct-to-camera monologue, conversational pacing, one idea per beat.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Publish consistently on a fixed weekly slot to train audience habit.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Pattern-interrupt every 30-45s (b-roll, graphic, or reframe) to reset attention.
seoChecklist: Primary keyword in first 8 words of title
Keyword in first line of description
End screen linking to related video
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Medium shot primary; tight close-up cutaways on emphasis lines.
ytd:videoTemplates.soundDesign: Whoosh on cuts, soft click on text pop-ins.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Cold open hook (0-15s) → Intro/context → 3-5 main points to camera → Recap → CTA/outro.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Viewers who want a direct opinion or explanation fast.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Face + 3-5 word bold text + high-contrast background.

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Mostly voiceover-over-footage; on-camera only for framing/closing.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Invite discussion/disagreement in comments rather than a hard ask.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Match cuts between narration and visual evidence, minimal jump cuts.
ytd:videoTemplates.equipment: Editing-heavy; camera only for bookend shots.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Minimal, editorial — pull quotes, source citations on screen.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Open on the central tension or question the essay resolves.
ytd:videoTemplates.motionGraphics: Slow Ken Burns pans on stills, understated transitions.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Video Essay
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Argumentative arc: claim, evidence, counterpoint, resolution.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Lower frequency, higher production value — evergreen SEO title.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Escalating stakes per section — each section should raise the question further before answering it.
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Archival/stock footage, screen recordings, and diagrams cut to narration beats.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Thesis stated up front → 3-4 sections building the argument → synthesis → closing thought.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Viewers seeking in-depth analysis or perspective.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Evocative single image + short provocative phrase.

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Multi-angle interviews, wide establishing shots, handheld verite b-roll.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Point to a follow-up video or full playlist.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Interview intercut with b-roll/archival, longer takes than talking-head.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Lower-thirds for interviewees, location/date title cards.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Open mid-scene on the most dramatic beat, then rewind to context.
ytd:videoTemplates.musicStyle: Score that tracks emotional beats of each act.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Documentary
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Observational or investigative arc following a real subject or event.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Tent-pole release, promoted across other videos/channels.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Withhold a key reveal until a later act to sustain the through-line.
seoChecklist: Full transcript in description for long-tail search
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Establishing wides, interview mediums, detail inserts.
ytd:videoTemplates.soundDesign: Natural ambient sound preserved, not overwhelmed by score.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Cold open scene → title card → context/backstory → chronological or thematic acts → resolution/epilogue.

ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Ask viewers if something similar happened to them.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Paced like fiction — hold on reactions, cut fast through exposition.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Minimal captions, occasional emphasis text on key lines.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Open at the most tense moment, then say "but let me back up."
ytd:videoTemplates.musicStyle: Emotionally reactive score, shifts with the story beats.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Storytelling
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Classic narrative arc, first- or third-person.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Series-friendly — good for a recurring story-time format.
seoChecklist: Title promises the stakes without spoiling the ending
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Reenactment b-roll, stock footage, or animated illustration matched to narration.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Hook with the stakes → setup → rising action → climax → resolution/lesson.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Viewers who want narrative/entertainment over information.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: A single striking "moment" image with an intriguing phrase.

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Overhead/macro for product detail, medium for talking head.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Link affiliate/purchase info, ask viewers what to review next.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Close-up product inserts intercut with talking head.
ytd:videoTemplates.equipment: Macro lens or close-focus camera, product turntable.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Lead with the single most surprising pro or con.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Review
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Evaluative — build toward a clear final verdict.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Publish close to product launch/news cycle for search traffic.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Tease the final verdict early, deliver full reasoning before confirming it.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: First impression hook → unboxing/overview → criteria-by-criteria breakdown → verdict/score.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Product hero shot + score or verdict word.

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Screen capture or overhead hands shot.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Link to source files/resources, ask what to tutorial next.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Screen recording or overhead cut tightly to each step, dead air removed.
ytd:videoTemplates.equipment: Screen recorder or overhead rig, clean audio.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Step counters, keyboard/click callouts, code/text overlays.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Show the finished result first: "here's what you'll be able to do."
ytd:videoTemplates.musicStyle: Light, low-key bed, mutes during key instructions.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Tutorial
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Procedural — one clear step at a time, no tangents.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Strong evergreen search candidate — title exactly how people would search.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Number the steps on screen so viewers can track progress.
seoChecklist: "How to" phrasing matched to real search queries
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Step-by-step screen/hands inserts, occasional talking head for context.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Outcome preview hook → prerequisites → numbered steps → final result recap.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Viewers trying to accomplish a specific task.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Before/after split or big step-count number.

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Talking head intros/outros, b-roll per item.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Ask viewers to comment their own #1.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Fast-paced, consistent per-item template (title card → footage → verdict).
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Big number badge per item, consistent lower-third template.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Tease #1 or the most surprising entry without naming it.
ytd:videoTemplates.motionGraphics: Number counter animation, item-card wipe transitions.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Top 10 / Listicle
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Highly clip/short-friendly — cut individual items into Shorts.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Consistent item numbering on screen keeps viewers counting toward the end.
seoChecklist: Each item timestamped as its own chapter
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Quick-cut footage per item matched to its specific claim.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Hook with the list's promise → items ranked ascending → recap of #1.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Bold number + collage of top items.

ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Link a deeper-dive video for viewers who want more.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Clean infographic style, consistent color-coding per concept.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Ask the question the whole internet is confused about.
ytd:videoTemplates.motionGraphics: Animated diagrams that build piece by piece.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Explainer
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Strong search/evergreen candidate for "what is X" queries.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Layer complexity gradually — never introduce two new ideas at once.
seoChecklist: "What is" / "How does X work" phrasing in title
Definition stated clearly in first 15s and in description
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Animated diagrams, whiteboard-style graphics, relevant stock footage.
ytd:videoTemplates.soundDesign: Soft UI-style blips for diagram reveals.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Hook the confusion/question → simplify the core concept → build up complexity → summary.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Curious viewers wanting a concept demystified.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Simple diagram or "?"-driven visual + short question text.

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Two-to-four camera setup, wide + individual speaker shots.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Push the audio-only version and timestamps.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Multi-cam switching on speaker, minimal cuts within a thought.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Lower-thirds for speakers, topic title cards per segment.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Open on the single best soundbite from the episode.
ytd:videoTemplates.motionGraphics: Minimal — waveform or subtle ambient background motion.
ytd:videoTemplates.musicStyle: Intro/outro stings only, silent during conversation.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Podcast (Video)
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Conversational, loosely structured around a topic list.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Long-form full episode + clipped short highlights across the week.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Segment markers/topic changes signaled visually to reset attention.
seoChecklist: Guest name in title if applicable
Full timestamped topic list in description
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Cutaways to reactions, wide shot for context.
ytd:videoTemplates.soundDesign: Clean multi-mic mix is the priority over SFX.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Cold open clip → intro → segments/topics → guest close-out (if any) → outro.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Viewers who want long-form conversation/background listening.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Host + guest faces, topic in bold text.

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Two-shot plus individual coverage of host and guest.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Point to the guest's own channel/links.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Two-shot with cutaway singles, trims dead air between Q&A.
ytd:videoTemplates.equipment: Two-camera, lav mics for both speakers.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Guest name/title lower-third, key quote callouts.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Open on the guest's most compelling answer.
ytd:videoTemplates.motionGraphics: Minimal, quote-card overlays for standout lines.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Interview
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Cross-promote with the guest's own audience.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Vary question topics/energy to avoid a flat single-tone conversation.
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Reaction cutaways, occasional b-roll relevant to the topic discussed.
ytd:videoTemplates.soundDesign: Clean dual-mic audio is the priority.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Guest intro hook → rapport-building questions → core topic questions → closing/plug.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Fans of the guest or the topic discussed.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Guest photo + provocative quote or question.

ytd:videoTemplates.cameraAngles: Single reaction cam, picture-in-picture over source clip.
ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Link the original source, credit the creator.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Picture-in-picture, pause-and-comment cuts on key moments.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Tease the specific moment that's about to shock/impress.
ytd:videoTemplates.musicStyle: None during playback; light bed on intro/outro only.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Reaction
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Real-time commentary layered over source content.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Fast turnaround on trending content maximizes reach.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Pause right before big moments to build anticipation before reacting.
seoChecklist: Source creator/title credited in title and description
Fair-use commentary is substantive, not just replay
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Reaction cam close-up, source content framed clearly.
ytd:videoTemplates.soundDesign: Balance source audio against reaction commentary carefully.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Setup what's about to be watched → play source with picture-in-picture reactions → wrap-up take.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Fans of the reactor and/or the source content.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: Exaggerated reaction face + source thumbnail inset.

ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Quick verbal or on-screen nudge to follow/watch the long-form version.
ytd:videoTemplates.editingStyle: Ultra-fast cuts, text-on-screen for sound-off viewing.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Bold captions, large legible text for muted viewing.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: First frame must show the payoff or the stakes — no slow build.
ytd:videoTemplates.motionGraphics: Snappy text pop-ins synced to speech.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: YouTube Shorts
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: One idea, no filler, vertical framing.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: High frequency, repurposed from longform highlights where possible.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: End on a beat that loops naturally back into the hook.
seoChecklist: Link to related longform video in description
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Single continuous shot or 2-3 quick cuts max.
ytd:videoTemplates.soundDesign: Punchy, minimal — one or two well-placed hits.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Hook in first 1s → single idea payoff → loop-friendly ending.
ytd:videoTemplates.thumbnailStyle: First frame doubles as the thumbnail — design accordingly.

ytd:videoTemplates.cta: Point to a companion series or source list.
ytd:videoTemplates.equipment: Full production kit — multi-cam, external audio, archival licensing.
ytd:videoTemplates.graphicsStyle: Editorial title cards, source citations, timeline graphics.
ytd:videoTemplates.hookFormula: Open on the unresolved mystery/question that drives the whole piece.
ytd:videoTemplates.musicStyle: Full original or licensed score tracking each act's tone.
ytd:videoTemplates.name: Longform Documentary
ytd:videoTemplates.narrativeFlow: Deep investigative arc across many sources and interviews.
ytd:videoTemplates.publishingStrategy: Rare tent-pole release, heavily promoted across the channel.
ytd:videoTemplates.retentionStrategy: Each act ends on a new question that reframes what came before.
seoChecklist: Detailed sourced description for credibility and search
ytd:videoTemplates.shotSuggestions: Archival footage, location b-roll, multiple interview setups.
ytd:videoTemplates.structure: Cold open → multi-act investigation (3-6 acts) → climax revelation → epilogue/reflection.
ytd:videoTemplates.targetAudience: Viewers seeking a deep, single-sitting investigative watch.
